findings.summary: The complete three-shell craft was readable during SOLITUDE S20 before the 161-second ANSWER reveal.
The aria-live region exposed authored shot prose as continuous narration.
The 320x568 ending wrapped the Japanese title poorly and exposed undersized controls.
The mobile control legend was too small, low-contrast, and visually obstructed.
Settings modal focus, trap, inert background, and restoration were incomplete.
The generated promotional thumbnail over-promised the runtime rendering.
Package-local source, build, report, and review bindings were incomplete.

release_effect: Candidate v1 was not deployed. A new immutable candidate requires a full independent review.
